steps.instruction: Inspect bound backend entities, tables and collections at the frozen head. For each target determine whether ownership can use an owner column or a prefixable identifier. Do not connect to a store.

steps.instruction: Reuse stable existing units and create or repair missing ones. Emit no partial plan when a required family has no valid target.

reads.when: when reusing an existing fixture namespace
